        dist[start][start] = 0
        while q:

                if dist[start][v] == -1:
                    dist[start][v] = dist[start][u] + 1
                    q.append(v)

                        best_move = neighbor
                new_positions.append(best_move)
            else:
                # Shouldn't happen since graph is connected
                new_positions.append(bee)

        # Output new positions
        print(' '.join(map(str, new_positions)))
        sys.stdout.flush()

        # Read Nastya's new position
        try:
            nastya_pos = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        except:
            break

        # Check if any bee is now at Nastya's position
        if nastya_pos in new_positions:
            break

        bee_positions = new_positions

if __name__ == '__main__':
